result.title: PersonaAgent: Retrieval-Augmented Transaction Anomaly Scoring with Refreshable Multi-Entity Persona Memory
result.summary: In large-scale payment networks, entities (card, merchant, etc.) and their interactions play a key role in transaction anomaly detection. However, transaction patterns between different entities usually change more frequently than the production model refresh schedule. Meanwhile, entity embedding tables suffer from high-cardinality and sparse interaction issues. To resolve the above challenges, we present PersonaAgent, an agentic transaction anomaly detection framework which represents the latest entity behavior signals as personas and saves them in a refreshable memory. Offline, a weekly scheduled batch job is used to extract the latest behavior signals and update them in the memory. At inference time, a lightweight adapter retrieves the corresponding entity behavior signals of each transaction from memory and uses them to augment the base anomaly classifier's scoring. Through comprehensive benchmarking with different anomaly detection models at Visa, PersonaAgent is able to score transactions efficiently (a 1,000-transaction CPU batch in 1-2 ms), lifting the PR-AUC by 0.65-6.58% and the production business metric by 8.93-14.24% relatively in deployment.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 PersonaAgent，将卡、商户等实体的最新行为信号表示为 persona 并存入可刷新记忆，离线定期批量更新，推理时由轻量适配器检索对应记忆来增强基础交易异常分类器的评分。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「可刷新实体记忆＋推理期轻量检索注入」与 LVR 中按实体或回合缓存视觉证据、择时注入的状态管理有形式相似，可能为证据缓存与刷新策略提供参照，但任务与视觉推理无关，迁移价值仍需较多核查。
